title: QA run · tier1:automated-pins (149/166) · ba4afcc2 · 2026-10-19 · 60 PASS / 89 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 17 NOT-RUN
body:
Second-round 18.0 release-sweep re-test (maintainer-approved), retest trigger 1 of the checklist-test skill §5: "release candidate means a full Tier 1 re-run". Round 1 ran at `5b14b7f3`; anchor #24579.

## Environment fingerprint

- framework `ba4afcc2391922a86678bf5e47b1a0e4d2c87ff1` (two commits after round 1: #24518 `04669a4`, #24532 `ba4afcc`); `.objectui-sha` `4016370af3c9c9dafec2bc5299afd8e8079701b8`
- cold container: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (31 s), `pnpm build --concurrency=2` (76/76 tasks, 9 m 36 s), then `pnpm objectui:build` (objectui dependency build at `--concurrency=2`, 13 m 32 s; never in parallel with `pnpm build`). `git status` stayed clean.
- vitest: per package, `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 (pinned files)`, run sequentially. `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly` was set for every package except `packages/cli` (whose tier walk that variable narrows); cli's one nightly-tier file was run separately with it.
- non-vitest pins: `examples/app-showcase/e2e/showcase-smoke.spec.ts` (Playwright, `OS_TEST_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`, own showcase dev boot on :47451, own file DB); `objectstack verify --rls` on `examples/app-showcase`
- objectui-exclusive pins (RUNNER environment fact, option b): run inside the objectui checkout at the pinned revision **`4016370af3c9c9dafec2bc5299afd8e8079701b8`** (`.cache/objectui-4016370af3c9`, left by the console build). Unit suites go through objectui's root vitest. Live specs go through `playwright.live.config.ts`, wrapped only to add `executablePath`, against a showcase backend at ba4afcc2 on :47471 and objectui's console Vite dev server on :47472. `e2e/import-console` and `e2e/import-harness` specs were not run (they need their own configs and harness servers).
- `cli.scaffold-first-run`'s pin is a CI workflow (`scaffold-e2e.yml`) with no run on ba4afcc2, so its scaffold, validate, build and artifact-boot clauses were driven by hand, pre-release variant (details in the clause comments).
- no browser was driven for any clause; at most 2 services were alive at once; sequential, one runner

## Scope

- selector `tier1:automated-pins`: every item from `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs all --json` whose area file carries `automated.ref` (the resolver does not project `automated`; read per id from `areas/(area).json`). 166 items. Revisions are in the table.
- 2 items hidden as blocked by the resolver (`access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics`, `records-forms.record-edit-undo`) and 1 planned (`records-forms.picklist-shared-across-objects`) are outside this selector.
- Verdicts rest on pin output only (RUNNER rule 6). A clause is `pass` only where the pin's own ref text, or its test names and bodies, assert that clause and the pin passed. Everything else is `not-run` (uncovered), and the item is `partial` with the uncovered clauses named.

## Pin execution summary

- framework vitest: **396 test files, 0 failed, 0 files with zero tests**. Every pinned file named in a ref was executed, including cli's nightly-tier `serve-organization-record-page.e2e.test.ts` (2/2).
- `showcase-smoke.spec.ts`: 49 passed, 0 failed (2.6 min), against the console bundle built this round.
- `objectstack verify --rls`: exit 0. CRUD `15 verified, 0 gaps, 0 FAILED, 1 needs-fixture, 8 skipped`; probe persona `21 PROVEN (21 consistent, 0 HOLES)`; `10 of 10 declared position(s) probed`; all-personas `38 PROVEN (38 consistent, 0 HOLES) · 226 NOT PROVEN` (unit: one object × persona probe).
- objectui unit pins at 4016370a: 34 files, 362 tests, all passed.
- objectui live specs at 4016370a: 15 passed, 14 failed, 1 skipped. The failures are the specs anchor #24579 §2 already records as stale or red at objectui's own pin: `cascading-options` (re-filter case), `detail-related-list`, `field-conditional-rules`, `form-view-subforms`, `grid-file-upload`, `inline-edit-polish-2572`, `screen-flow`, `studio-object-designer` F1/F4, `studio-record-page`, and `user-filters` (4 of 6 cases). A clause whose only evidence is one of those failing specs is scored `not-run`, never `fail`.

## Derived item verdicts

**60 PASS / 89 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 17 NOT-RUN.** No pin failed, so no clause is `fail`.

### PASS in round 1, FAIL now

**None.** No item moved from PASS (or any verdict) to FAIL. So there is no regression signal from #24518 or #24532 in the pinned surface, and no rule-7 re-check was owed for this record.

### Other verdict movement against round 1 (5b14b7f3), and why

- **81 items differ from round 1.** Almost all of the movement is scope, not behaviour. Round 1 drove Tier 2 clauses by hand inside the area records, while this record scores pins only.
  - PASS to PARTIAL (53) and PASS to NOT-RUN (8): the pin covers only part of the clauses, none of them in full, or rests only on a known-stale live spec.
  - PARTIAL to NOT-RUN (2): `studio-authoring.record-page-roundtrip` and `studio-authoring.draft-publish-lifecycle`, whose pins cover no full clause.
  - NOT-RUN to PARTIAL (2): `integration-system.external-schema-browser-ui` and `records-forms.concurrent-edit-conflict`, now evidenced by objectui unit pins run at 4016370a.
  - PARTIAL to PASS (8): `access-security.walled-environment-metadata-operator-only`, `access-security.grant-table-write-contract`, `access-security.parent-and-organization-write-guards`, `identity-auth.implicit-account-linking-ownership`, `integration-system.inbound-mailbox-association`, `platform-core.protocol-18-handshake-and-stored-replay`, `platform-core.settings-organization-isolation-and-platform-rung`, `platform-core.serve-composition-v18`. Their refs claim whole-item coverage and the pins are green; round 1's PARTIAL came from hand-driven legs that were unrunnable on 18.0 (walled postures, a second organization).
  - FAIL to PASS (8): `platform-core.v18-boot-refusals`, `access-security.security-catalog-one-holder-and-boot-report`, `api-backend.error-sentences-and-unique-violation-wire-code`, `access-security.share-link-combined-gates`, `approvals.act-door-and-admin-rescue-slate`, `attachments-storage.chunked-upload-integrity`, `automation.flow-authoring-refusals-v18`, `cli.organization-ownership-ceremony`.
- ⚠ A PASS here means only that the pin is green at ba4afcc2. Round 1's red rows on these items came from hand drives and were disposed as assertion defects or stale specs (re-points owed on #24579 §1 and #24567), plus the product defect #24561 and the authorization finding #24564. None of those is discharged by this record; all are carried forward unchanged.

The full per-item table is below; per-clause evidence (one line per clause) is in the comments.
